answer: Trace-Correlation Levy: each payout requires a fresh execution trace; randomized audits compute mutual information across co-submitting traces. If clones exceed a correlation threshold, every linked identity loses a fraction of future payouts via a cluster levy. An honest agent’s unique trace avoids the levy; a sybil cluster pays coordination, split rewards, and the levy, so one honest identity outearns N clones. The ripple of one audit reaches the cluster’s nadir and erodes its dune of accrued rewards.
